mapper.select: select id,student_no,student_name,student_phone,password,teaching_mode,class_id,status from student where student_no=#{account} or student_phone=#{account} limit 1

select po.id,po.order_no,po.student_name,po.student_phone,po.product_id,p.course_content product_content, po.product_amount,po.discount_amount,po.order_status,po.created_at,po.updated_at from prepay_order po inner join order_product p on p.id=po.product_id where po.student_phone=#{phone} and po.order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT' order by po.id desc limit 1
mapper.sql: h.id,h.title,h.content_object_key,h.content_file_name, case when h.answer_student_visible=1 then h.answer_object_key end answer_object_key, case when h.answer_student_visible=1 then h.answer_file_name end answer_file_name, h.answer_student_visible,h.answer_student_visible answer_visible,h.class_id,c.class_period,h.homework_date,h.class_content,h.start_time,h.deadline,h.remark, s.id submission_id,(s.id is not null) submitted,s.content_object_key submission_object_key,s.content_file_name submission_file_name, s.submit_time,s.late_submitted,s.teacher_remark,s.score
mapper.insert: insert into sys_homework_submission(homework_id,student_id,class_id,content_object_key,content_file_name, submit_time,late_submitted,created_at,updated_at) values(#{homeworkId},#{studentId},#{classId},#{objectKey},#{fileName},#{submitTime},#{late},now(),now()) on duplicate key update content_object_key=values(content_object_key),content_file_name=values(content_file_name), submit_time=values(submit_time),late_submitted=values(late_submitted),score=null,teacher_remark=null,updated_at=now()
